measurement: MP-REL3/AX native inspection with a fresh release build, and why interaction is blocked
inspection_worked: A release build from a fresh target directory creates a window named 'COS Desktop' (class Zed::Window). Two independent accessibility paths read it: UI Automation reports 48 descendants with automation ids including TitleBar, task-search, task-row-fixture:task/Task-184 and the candidate rows, and Orca's computer-use surface reports the same window with a 46-line tree.
interaction_blocked: Keyboard input cannot be delivered in this session. UI Automation's SetForegroundWindow returns false even after AttachThreadInput, and the foreground window belongs to another process; SendKeys therefore reaches nothing, and the same shortcut posted as window messages leaves the descendant count unchanged at 48 with no panel ids. Orca reports window_not_focused for the chord and says the same after --restore-window, so a second, independent tool confirms the window cannot be focused.
consequence: Everything that needs keyboard input stays NOT_OBSERVED: opening the diagnostics panel with the shortcut, Tab and Shift+Tab traversal, the save dialog and its overwrite confirmation. The panel ids (diagnostic-readonly, support-preview-readonly, support-export-button, support-export-status) could not be listed because the panel never opened.
